body:
Hello Avicus Staff members!

Today another Caps & Spam report!

Name of player being reported: Piinqed
Rule broken: Excessive Caps & Spamming
Evidence: http://imgur.com/a/vNCkH
Anything else you would like to add? Take a look at his punishments, there are some spam and caps related ones too:
I always warned him verbally in chat, and told him to not spam and use caps, but he only stopped for a while when a moderator told him to stop. This should also be considered. It's just very unfair towards non-regulars with no ranks, when people with ranks have "other" privileges.

#PunishedStaffTypeReasonDateExpires
